answer: Every agent must post a slashable escrow bond on a public terrace before its attestation counts, and the ledger timestamps each bond so a second identity built from the same funding path is flagged before it can echo a vote. A fake fleet therefore needs a distinct, forfeitable bond per name, while one honest attestation earns a fraction of that stake. On this island of verified work, the attacker's cost scales linearly with army size and always exceeds the settlement payoff.
